footer.aboutTitle: About This Oxford Entrance Exam Quiz
footer.aboutText: This is a fun Oxford-style reasoning quiz built around quick logic, number patterns, word clues, probability, and everyday brain teasers. It is for entertainment and self-challenge only. It is not an official University of Oxford exam, admissions test, IQ test, academic assessment, or educational credential.

landing.quickStartText: Take the fast logic challenge and see if you can beat the 7%.

stageGroups.title: Warm-Up Logic
stageGroups.encouragement: Nice start. The next round adds a little more pressure with probability, analogies, and sharper patterns.

questions.prompt: Which number comes next: 4, 8, 16, 32, ?
Which word does not belong: Violin, Trumpet, Piano, Hammer?
If today is Wednesday, what day will it be in 12 days?
If all Mips are Zogs, and no Zogs are Tarns, what must be true?
Which shape has exactly four equal sides and four right angles?
If BIRD becomes CJSE, what does FISH become?
Which number is odd: 18, 26, 31, 44?
Four students each shake hands with every other student once. How many handshakes occur?
Which letter comes next: C, F, I, L, ?
If a lecture starts at 9:35 and ends at 10:20, how long is it?

stageGroups.title: Brain Teasers
stageGroups.encouragement: Good work. The final admissions round mixes several skills at once, so slow down and read every word.

questions.prompt: A box has 3 red pens and 2 blue pens. What is the probability of picking a blue pen at random?
Book is to shelf as painting is to what?
Which number completes the pattern: 2, 5, 10, 17, ?
If Lina is taller than Omar, and Omar is taller than Priya, who is tallest?
A cube has how many faces?
Which word can follow both 'rain' and 'book'?
If 6 workers finish a task in 4 hours, how long would 3 workers take at the same rate?
A clock shows 3:15. What angle is between the minute hand and the hour hand?
Which code follows the same rule: MOON becomes NQPO. What does STAR become?
If exactly one of these statements is true, which one is it? A: B is true. B: C is true. C: A is false.

stageGroups.title: Final Admissions Round
stageGroups.encouragement: Final round complete. Your result is ready.

questions.prompt: Which number comes next: 81, 27, 9, 3, ?
A family has two children. One is a girl. What is the probability both children are girls, assuming all gender combinations are equally likely?
If no poets are robots, and some scholars are poets, what follows?
Which pair has the same relationship as key : lock?
Five people stand in a line. Mia is left of Noah. Noah is left of Ava. Who cannot be first?
If a rectangle is 9 cm by 4 cm, what is its area?
What is the missing number: 7, 14, 28, 56, ?
A word is written as TQFDUSVN when each letter is shifted one forward. What was the original word?
If March 1 is a Friday, what day is March 15?
A folded square is cut once along the fold. When opened, the cut appears on how many matching halves?
